text_block_list.text:
As I passed through the academy's central 
courtyard, I spotted Yaeno Muteki and her 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I would like everyone to just 
enjoy their time as usual.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I don't mind that, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Talking with Creek-san right next to you, 
Yaeno-san... U-Um, are you really sure I'm 
not bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nay, that is fine. Banishing distracting 
thoughts and clearing one's mind... that 
is how one's concentration is honed, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-dono. With the help of Chiyono 
O-san and Creek-san, we are about to begin 
meditating.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Focusing one's mind without being 
distracted by surrounding sounds... Would 
you like to join me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Umm, umm, just do what I always do... 
Doing what I always do is so hard, 
though...!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, what do we usually talk about, 
I wonder~... Oh, how about that curry I 
made the other day~?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san's curry! It was so delicious! It 
really warms you right up!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, was it a bit too sweet? I used mild 
roux, and added some honey too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"No, not at all! I guess it's just been so 
long since I had mild curry, it made me 
feel nostalgic!"

What a peaceful conversation this is... 
I'm curious about the mild curry, but I'm 
meditating right now. I must concentrate 
harder...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...So, I was thinking Tama-chan might 
just be going through her rebellious 
phase."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-Is that how it is...!? I wonder if 
my little sister had a "terrible twos" 
phase too...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'd love to meet Chiyono O-chan's 
younger sister someday too~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh right~ I bought some delicious juice at 
the school store earlier, and apparently 
it's super popular with little kids too—

"...As usual, I couldn't help overhearing 
the conversation next to us... Wondering 
how Yaeno Muteki was taking it, I looked 
over, and—"

She didn't pay it any mind at all. What 
incredible focus. Just as I straightened 
my posture, determined to follow her 
example...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Kya...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp!

The moment the scream rang out, Yaeno 
Muteki moved faster than the eye could 
follow!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm all right, nothing spilled.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much! Whoa, did you 
just catch that mid-air...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry~! My hand slipped a little... 
I ended up interrupting your training, 
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, it is fine. The Kongo Yaegaki style is 
a power meant to protect... To wield it 
like this is its true purpose.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I'm just glad everyone's 
clothes didn't get wet.

Despite being so deeply focused in 
meditation, Yaeno Muteki reacted to a 
faint cry and stepped in to save her 
friend—
choice_data_list:
It's amazing how you could move like that 
on the spur of the moment!

That's something only someone with 
kindness at their core could do

That's something you can do because you're 
kind at heart, you know

text_block_list.text:
Despite being so deeply focused in 
meditation, Yaeno Muteki reacted to a 
faint cry and stepped in to save her 
friend—
choice_data_list:
It's amazing how you could move like that 
on the spur of the moment!

That's something only someone with 
kindness at their core could do

That's something you can do because you're 
kind at heart, you know

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Of course, I believe 
it is also the fruit of my Kongo 
Yaegaki-style training, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"As for explosive power, I believe much of 
it was built through your training, 
Trainer-dono."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I shall display this speed in 
an actual race. Please look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So please... continue to guide and teach 
me! Osu!

Yaeno Muteki is full of drive for the 
upcoming race. I need to match her 
enthusiasm and guide her through our 
training...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: K-Kindness... you say?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, I am merely adhering to the teachings 
of the Kongo Yaegaki style. It is not 
because I am inherently kind—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“A strong carrot is fluffy and sweet”! 
Yaeno-san is truly very kind!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's right~ She always comes to 
everyone's rescue just like a dashing 
knight, so cool and terribly gentle~♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I don't think... there are any, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Um... I will gratefully accept your words 
of praise...

The desire 'to protect' that lies at Yaeno 
Muteki's core... It was a day that let me 
catch a glimpse of that!
